split_reasoning: Day-to-day direction is live supervision, while formal evaluation produces a written appraisal.

parts.text: Direct and supervise the work of unit personnel.
parts.type_reasoning: Live supervision with nothing separately checked.

parts.text: Evaluate a staff member's work performance in writing.
parts.type_reasoning: Each appraisal is a document HR and the employee rely on.
parts.unit_reasoning: Appraisals are done per employee.
parts.start: appraisal period closes for an employee

split_reasoning: One activity: setting objectives and criteria for a unit.

parts.text: Set objectives and evaluative or operational criteria for the unit.
parts.type_reasoning: Produces a written set of objectives and criteria others are measured against.
parts.unit_reasoning: Set for a unit at planning time and approved as a whole.
parts.work_item: one set of unit objectives and criteria
parts.end: objectives and criteria approved and communicated

split_reasoning: Hiring produces a filled post; training is a live activity.

parts.text: Direct or conduct recruitment and hiring of personnel.
parts.type_reasoning: Each vacancy ends in a hire.
parts.unit_reasoning: One process per vacancy.

parts.text: Direct or conduct training of personnel.
parts.type_reasoning: Live teaching with no checked output.

split_reasoning: Building or changing a records system differs from producing reports from it.

parts.text: Develop or maintain a computerized record management system for data such as personnel information.
parts.type_reasoning: Each system change is delivered and relied on by users.
parts.unit_reasoning: Changes or setups are delivered one at a time.
parts.work_item: one records system setup or modification
parts.end: change in use and accepted by users

parts.text: Produce a report from the record system.
parts.type_reasoning: Each report goes to a requester.
parts.unit_reasoning: Reports are produced and sent individually.
parts.work_item: one report produced from the system

split_reasoning: Developing a policy or procedure and implementing it are distinct activities with different outputs.

parts.text: Develop or revise an organizational policy or procedure.
parts.type_reasoning: Development produces a policy or procedure document for approval and use.
parts.unit_reasoning: An individual policy or procedure is reviewed and approved as a whole.
parts.start: need for a new or revised policy or procedure is identified

parts.text: Implement an approved organizational policy or procedure.
parts.type_reasoning: Implementation produces a rollout instruction or implementation plan used by affected staff.
parts.unit_reasoning: The implementation instructions for one approved policy are communicated and tracked together.
parts.work_item: one policy implementation instruction or rollout plan
parts.start: policy or procedure is approved for implementation
parts.end: implementation instructions are issued to responsible staff

notes: Live staff training associated with implementation may be covered separately by training tasks.

split_reasoning: Accounting, budgeting, expenditure authorization, rate setting, and financial reporting coordination produce different financial items.

parts.text: Conduct or oversee accounting for facility operations.
parts.type_reasoning: Accounting produces discrete reviewed financial records.
parts.unit_reasoning: A period's accounts or reconciliation are reviewed and closed together.
parts.start: period transactions and account records are available
parts.end: reconciliation is reviewed and filed or forwarded

parts.text: Plan a budget for facility operations.
parts.type_reasoning: Budget planning produces a financial plan for approval.
parts.unit_reasoning: A unit or facility budget for a planning period is submitted as a whole.
parts.end: budget proposal is submitted for approval

parts.text: Review and authorize expenditures.
parts.type_reasoning: Each authorization produces an approval or rejection that purchasing and finance staff use.
parts.unit_reasoning: An expenditure request is reviewed and decided individually.

parts.text: Establish or revise rates for services.
parts.type_reasoning: Rate setting produces a schedule or recommendation used for charging and financial planning.
parts.unit_reasoning: A proposed rate or related set of rates is reviewed and approved together.
parts.work_item: one service rate or rate schedule proposal
parts.start: rate review or new service pricing is requested
parts.end: proposed rate or schedule is submitted for approval

parts.text: Coordinate financial reporting for the facility.
parts.type_reasoning: Coordination results in a completed financial report assembled for management or other recipients.
parts.unit_reasoning: Each scheduled or requested financial report is delivered as a whole.
parts.start: reporting period ends or report is requested

notes: Shares are approximate and depend on the finance functions delegated to specialist staff.

parts.text: Set staff work schedules and assignments according to workload, space and equipment.
parts.type_reasoning: Each schedule is published for staff to follow.
parts.unit_reasoning: Schedules are issued per period.
parts.work_item: one schedule for a scheduling period

split_reasoning: One activity: attending meetings and coordinating.

parts.text: Attend board meetings and coordinate between the board, medical staff and department heads.
parts.type_reasoning: Value is in the meetings.

parts.text: Monitor use of diagnostic services, beds, facilities and staff and assess need for more resources.
parts.type_reasoning: Produces a utilization finding and request for management.
parts.unit_reasoning: Reviews are done periodically per resource.
parts.work_item: one utilization review with resource recommendation
parts.end: findings and recommendation sent to management

parts.text: Stay aware of developments in medicine, technology, regulation and financing.
parts.type_reasoning: Nothing is produced for others.

split_reasoning: Planning a change differs from leading staff through it.

parts.text: Lead staff through change such as restructuring and new technology.
parts.type_reasoning: Live leadership with no checked output.

parts.text: Write a change implementation plan.
parts.type_reasoning: Produces a plan others rely on.
parts.unit_reasoning: One plan per change initiative.

parts.text: Prepare an activity report on program, service and quality initiative status.
parts.type_reasoning: Each report is relied on by management.
parts.unit_reasoning: Reports go out per period.

split_reasoning: Planning and administering programs produce different items, while staff coordination is a live interaction.

parts.text: Plan a health care program or service.
parts.type_reasoning: Planning produces a documented program or service plan for approval and use.
parts.unit_reasoning: A defined program or service plan is submitted and reviewed as a unit.
parts.start: program or service planning need is identified
parts.end: plan is submitted to the responsible leadership
parts.checked_by: facility leadership and affected department heads

parts.text: Implement and administer a health care program or service.
parts.type_reasoning: Administration generates discrete implementation instructions or decisions for staff to carry out.
parts.unit_reasoning: A defined operational instruction or decision is issued and acted on separately from the overall program.
parts.work_item: one program implementation instruction or operational decision
parts.start: an implementation step or operational issue requires action
parts.end: instruction or decision is communicated to responsible staff

parts.text: Coordinate and train personnel involved in facility programs and services.
parts.type_reasoning: Coordination and training are carried out through live discussion and instruction.

notes: Shares depend on program maturity and how much personnel administration is delegated.

parts.text: Consult with medical, business and community groups.
parts.type_reasoning: Value is in the interaction.

split_reasoning: Walking the facility is physical; writing recommendations is computer work.

parts.text: Inspect facilities on site.
parts.type_reasoning: Requires being on site.

parts.text: Write recommendations for building or equipment changes.
parts.type_reasoning: Produces a report management acts on.
parts.unit_reasoning: One report per inspection.

parts.text: Review and analyze facility data for planning, cash and risk management and utilization.
parts.type_reasoning: Yields an analysis management relies on.
parts.unit_reasoning: Analyses done per question or period.

split_reasoning: Developing or expanding a program and implementing an approved program are distinct activities.

parts.text: Develop or propose an expansion of a medical program or health service.
parts.type_reasoning: Development produces a proposal for leadership and partners to assess.
parts.unit_reasoning: A defined program or expansion proposal is submitted for a decision as a whole.
parts.work_item: one medical program or service expansion proposal
parts.start: program or service need is identified
parts.end: proposal is submitted to decision makers
parts.checked_by: facility leadership and relevant clinical or community partners

parts.text: Implement an approved medical program or health service.
parts.type_reasoning: Implementation produces defined instructions or plans for responsible staff.
parts.unit_reasoning: A launch or implementation plan for a defined program component is reviewed and issued as a whole.
parts.work_item: one program or service implementation plan
parts.start: program or expansion is approved for implementation
parts.end: implementation plan is issued to responsible staff

notes: Research, rehabilitation, and community health are alternative program subjects.

parts.text: Develop instructional materials.
parts.type_reasoning: Produces materials others use.
parts.unit_reasoning: Per course or module.

parts.text: Conduct in-service and community education programs.
parts.type_reasoning: Live teaching.
